resources.effective_memory: Minimum of current MemAvailable and each visible ancestor's finite memory.max/current and memory.high/current headroom, clamped at zero. memory.high is treated as a conservative throttle boundary, not mislabeled a hard limit.
resources.cgroup_rule: Exactly one membership line containing the single valid 0:: path; exactly one visible cgroup2 mount at /sys/fs/cgroup with root /. Walk self membership to the visible root, at most16 levels. Unknown/hybrid/nonstandard layouts or partial memory/PID pairs refuse without fallback.
resources.optional_controller_rule: Both memory.current and memory.max may be absent at a level (including the root); any existing visible ancestor constraints are still considered. Both-absent is not described as evidence that hidden ancestors have no constraints.
resources.pid_and_cpu: Record visible pids.current/max and cpu.max at the same levels. Require at least one visible remaining PID before the optional child, when constrained; record CPU affinity count. No CPU capacity reservation is claimed.
resources.bootstrap_limit: Python and the listed standard-library imports necessarily start before the first in-process resource guard. No heavier work precedes that guard.
resources.growth_limit_note: A racing file growth may consume one additional bounded read block before refusal. File bodies are streamed, not accumulated.
resources.memory_limit_scope: The resource floor is current available headroom, not an address-space/RSS cap, future allocation guarantee or assertion about invisible ancestors.

execution_and_closure.timeout_behavior: An internal expiry or any guard/read/hash/version error ends the attempt. The source may SIGKILL only its still-live Popen-created Node process group and wait for that child; no unrelated PID is signaled.
execution_and_closure.output_behavior: Both captured child stream byte prefixes have exact hexadecimal custody and explicit completion/truncation flags. Any timeout/cap failure remains a failure; no second child or fallback path.
execution_and_closure.external_receiving: Use the actual returned/ready matching PID for read_process_output if the start tool has not already supplied final completion. These are output reads for this one known process, not a device/process census. Retain exact invocation/start/output envelopes, final exit and reported runtime; receipt alone does not prove self closure.
execution_and_closure.acceptance: Require literal completed:true, actual matching outer exit0 and an externally recorded native/tool runtime within20s. If Node was called, require actual wait/poll/reap, exit0, untruncated complete streams and valid version text. Missing/unknown external completion never becomes success.
execution_and_closure.unknown_start: An MCP timeout/offline response without actual PID/output leaves the operation UNKNOWN. Do not resend, fall back, infer closure or perform discovery/history probes. Preserve it and return the status to root.
execution_and_closure.no_global_pid_claim: Owned Popen wait/poll proves child reaping. The parent cannot declare its own absence; no universal PID-absence claim is made.

interpretation_and_preservation: This establishes bounded runtime metadata only. SQLite support for any SQL feature and Node compatibility with the lesson parser remain untested and require a separate frozen task.
Pinning source/cache candidates and matching loaded SQLite/Python libraries is a declared partial runtime closure; no full OS dependency or Node shared-library closure is claimed.

Files are stable during their streamed hash reads and have matching post-observation path/stat identities. The source performs no second full-content hash; this is not stronger concurrent-change proof.
The original d1f87 source and its sole reversible membership correction remain available. No syntax/AST/runtime source verification has been performed.
All54 missing ControlEngine artifact identities and the Mac offline/UNKNOWN collector dispositions remain unchanged.

primary_sources.basis: Controller constraints are hierarchical; v1 and v2 may coexist; memory.high is a throttle/reclaim boundary, memory.max a hard limit. This proposal refuses hybrid membership and uses the minimum of visible max/high headroom conservatively.
sqlite_version/sqlite_version_info expose runtime SQLite metadata. Reading these and module file identities requires no database connection or query.
-I isolates Python environment/search paths; -B prevents bytecode writes; -S suppresses site startup; -u leaves output unbuffered.

retention: This proposal uses inert Git blob objects in Jacob-Met/hamon. All listed objects are created and exact-read-back; no branch/ref/commit publication is performed here. Unreferenced object availability is not a retention anchor.
